text:
dan_sales: Prospect asked for a POC where inference, KMS, and control-plane calls must remain inside "us-east-1-wl5". They also attached a security questionnaire asking for subprocessor names on the network path and a pricing uplift for dedicated edge tenancy. What's the short answer and what docs do we need?
infra_lina: Short: We can place inference compute in wl5 (Dedicated/Private) but full control-plane in-zone is not standard. For POC we can: 1) run runtime in wl5, 2) accept BYO-KMS in their VPC, 3) stand up a lightweight control-plane proxy in their VPC to avoid egress. That proxy requires infra changes and a 3-5 day validation window.
legal_raj: For the subprocessor list we can provide Redwood subproc manifest (auth, monitoring, storage). Carrier/ISP subprocessors (e.g., "NorthBridge Mobile LLC") are third parties; we can request attestation from them but can't unilaterally certify their contract terms. Security questionnaire: ask which fields are must-have vs nice-to-have.
dan_sales: They flagged two SQ items as must-have: "network-path subprocessors" and "key residency proof". They also asked for a one-off price for isolated edge tenancy during the POC. Can ops give a ballpark uplift?
ops_miguel: Ballpark: POC uplift = base dedicated rate + 20-40% for single-zone isolation and on-call support. Exact quote depends on instance SKU and expected RPS. Request QPS, avg seq len, and expected test duration. Also need carrier POA and ENI/peering contact.
infra_lina: Operational checklist to share with customer: - BYO-KMS ARN + endpoint reachable inside wl5 VPC - Carrier peering docs / ENI info - Network diagram with route tables & MTU - Expected traffic profile (qps, concurrency, seq) - Which SQ fields are non-negotiable
dan_sales: I'll ask procurement for QPS and attach the SQ with must-have flags. Also they want an ops snippet showing a routing policy that prefers wl5 and rejects requests if wl5 cannot service them (no fallback). Can we include that?
infra_lina: Yes—share this minimal policy example and a short caveat paragraph.

```yaml
routing_policy:
  mode: "zone-strict"
  preferred_zone: "us-east-1-wl5"
  fallback: []
  byo_kms: true
  telemetry: "minimal"
  kv_cache: "disabled"
```

infra_lina: Caveat: "zone-strict" will cause request rejection if wl5 lacks capacity. For POC we can enable canary routing but production should include a documented failover.
sla_bot: NOTE: POC isolation may not be SLA-backed until infra validation completes.
legal_raj: I'll draft a short DPA appendix for POC-only subproc language and a template attestation request for the carrier. Send me the carrier legal entity name and any jurisdictional identifiers.
dan_sales: Carrier listed is "NorthBridge Mobile LLC (NJ)" in the RFP. I'll return with QPS and the completed SQ with must-have flags. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
